title: Invocation API V2 Migration (Deterministic Invocation Context)
notes: Run each step in the component's repository root.
A step is complete when its detect command outputs nothing (no matches).
The framework enforces a barrier: all components must pass a step before proceeding to the next.

steps.name: Add Invocation + V2 constructors (recipe-core)
steps.description: In recipe-core, add ops.Invocation struct with fields {RecipeID, NodePath, InvokeSeq, BoxID, ActivityID, ID} and method Key(). Add new handler types InlineHandlerV2 and ActivityHandlerV2 that take (inv Invocation, ...). Add constructors NewInlineOpV2 and NewActivityMappedOpV2 that bind these handler types.
steps.detect: bash -lc '(! grep -RIl --exclude-dir vendor --exclude-dir node_modules --exclude INVOCATION_API_MIGRATION.md --exclude INVOCATION_API_MIGRATION.json -E

detect.name: Worker passes Invocation to ops
detect.description: In recipe-worker, compute Invocation {RecipeID, NodePath, InvokeSeq, BoxID, ActivityID, ID=Key()} per call and invoke ops via V2 signatures: InlineHandlerV2(inv, workflow.Context, ...) and ActivityHandlerV2(inv, context.Context, ...). Remove any Invocation-less calls.

detect.name: Ops use V2 constructors
detect.description: In server/ops, switch all ops to NewInlineOpV2/NewActivityMappedOpV2 with V2 handler signatures that accept Invocation. Remove usage of NewInlineOp, NewActivityMappedOp, and NewActivityMappedOpWithManagement.

detect.name: API tests post id in respond/cancel
detect.description: In server/api tests, ensure POST /api/user-inputs/{workflowID}/respond and /cancel bodies include an "id" field. Remove any tests that post without id.

detect.name: Remove V1 constructors and signatures (recipe-core)
detect.description: Delete legacy NewInlineOp and NewActivityMappedOp constructors and any V1 handler types. Ensure server/ops is fully migrated to V2 before removal.

detect.name: OpenAPI schemas include id
detect.description: Update OpenAPI (be-openapi/fe-openapi) request schemas for respond/cancel to require "id" and regenerate code. Ensure generated clients and servers use the new shape.

detect.name: Eliminate deprecated code
detect.description: Remove any remaining adapters, legacy invocation paths, or shims related to V1 invocation. Ensure no references to V1 constructors or Invocation-less signatures remain.
